verified_behavior.reproduced: A legacy ATTEMPTING entry, with empty cloud and phone views, let Sync report complete. Receiving that source again created another request ID.
verified_behavior.held_requests: Installed owner-scoped PREPARED and ATTEMPTING records retain original encrypted bytes and request identity. Ordinary capture/upload and completion respect that uncertainty. CONFIRMED and MATCHED_EXISTING compact to the original v2 terminal format with request ID, source ID and row digest, omitting the body. Unreadable protected data is preserved.
verified_behavior.consent_and_ack: Legacy code 48 omitted the original consent generation. The client leaves those requests held without replay. The server composition keeps raw held routes unavailable. Ordinary and held acknowledgments require zero financial effects expressed as an integer.
verified_behavior.foreground: The former GatewayFactory failed the Replace invalidation check. Pause, replacement and retirement invalidate pending success. The notification and foreground model require the original monotonic five-minute freshness window, observed inbox and revision, stable receiver control revision, attached session observer and SMS permissions. A late worker cannot restore success.
verified_behavior.historical_limit: The earlier signed build's independent profile and SIM wall-clock deadline coverage, physical carrier behavior and managed production service remain outside this local evidence.
